jobs.title: Staff Generative AI Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptional Staff Generative AI Engineer to join our team. This is a critical, deeply hands-on role for a seasoned software engineer with a profound passion for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic frameworks. You will be instrumental in designing, building, and deploying real-world, commercial production systems, not just proofs-of-concept.

As a Staff Generative AI Engineer, you will:

Architect & Build Production Systems: Lead the hands-on development of sophisticated Generative AI applications, LLM-powered solutions, and intricate agentic frameworks primarily using Python. Your code will be clean, performant, scalable, and deployed directly into commercial production environments, solving real business problems.
Pioneer Automation with Agents: Design and implement intelligent agents capable of understanding, reasoning, and orchestrating complex workflows to automate critical enterprise business processes, driving efficiency and reducing operational risk at scale.
Master Containerized Deployments: Demonstrate deep comfort and expertise with container technologies, particularly deploying and managing applications within OpenShift environments.
Drive Technical Direction & Ownership: Contribute significantly to the technical strategy and roadmap for Generative AI adoption, influencing architectural decisions and technology choices across our product portfolio, ensuring all solutions are production-ready.
Champion Engineering Excellence: Instill and uphold rigorous software engineering best practices, including robust testing, code reviews, documentation, and continuous integration/delivery, ensuring the highest quality for our mission-critical systems running in production.
Innovate & Research: Stay at the bleeding edge of Generative AI, actively exploring new models, techniques, and frameworks.
Contribute to both applied engineering and research initiatives within the domain. You will have access to state-of-the-art AI- assisted development tools like Devin and Copilot to amplify your productivity and creativity.
Mentor & Collaborate: Act as a technical leader and mentor to junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.
Iterate & Deliver: Thrive in an agile, fast-paced environment, prioritizing rapid delivery, iterative development, and adaptability.
Focus on delivering measurable business value and learning quickly from prototypes and deployments, always with a path to production in mind.
Ensure Responsible AI: Design and implement robust guardrails and ethical considerations into AI solutions, proactively assessing and mitigating risks in line with organizational and regulatory standards.
Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating,
managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, demonstrating a strong track record of designing, building, and delivering scalable enterprise-grade solutions in commercial production environments, not just proofs-of-concept.
Expert-level proficiency in Python is a must-have, with a deep understanding of its ecosystem for AI/ML development, data engineering, and backend services. Full-stack development experience is a distinct advantage.
Extensive hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), transformer architectures, RAG, and advanced agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK. Optionally AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel).
Deep comfort and practical experience with containers and orchestration technologies, specifically OpenShift.
Demonstrated ability to architect, develop, and deploy highly performant, large-scale AI/ML systems into production
environments.
Strong understanding of modern software development principles, clean code practices, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
Proficiency with Relational (preferably, PostgreSQL) and Vector (preferably, pgvector) databases.

Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points):

Practical experience in model risk management, developing AI guardrails, and establishing end-user adoption pathways for Generative AI solutions.
A proven track record of contributing to open-source projects or publishing relevant research in AI/ML.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: R&D Head – Agentic AI , Kitchener, Ontario
jobs.description:
Change the future with us.

We are looking for dedicated and talented people who solve ever-changing challenges, customer needs, and questions from colleagues with clever concepts and creativity. We embrace change and work with curious minds re-inventing the future of work. Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world.

About the role:
R&D Team Leader
- Agentic AI

Are you an entrepreneurial technology leader with a passion for building high-performing R&D teams and turning advanced AI concepts into scalable industrial platforms?

We are seeking an outstanding R&D Team Leader
to join Siemens Digital Industries Operations Software
, to lead an Agentic AI
team, based in Kitchener, Ontario – shipping real agent capabilities fast, while staying tightly aligned with the shared platform architecture and standards set across the program.

In this leadership role, you will lead and build the Canada’s Agentic AI team, and drive the development of secure, scalable, customer-ready platforms and shape the future of industrial AI.

Siemens Digital Industries Operations Software
is a suite of integrated digital solutions to engineer, simulate and operate manufacturing operations across industries. Operations Software includes our product portfolio in manufacturing engineering (COMOS, Tecnomatix, NX CAM, ...) & production operations (Win CC, Scada, PCS 7 / neo, Opcenter, Insights Hub, ...). The portfolio helps organizations across many different industries to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance decision-making by providing real-time visibility and control across manufacturing and business processes.

Formula 1 cars, ships, mobile phones, space exploration vehicles, food & beverages, pharmaceuticals and many of the other objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and produced using our software.

We're redefining the industrial world using data and AI to make production: Agile, Adaptive, Autonomous. Eliminate productivity boundaries for today’s and tomorrow’s production operation. Join our mission to build the most comprehensive next generation AI-native Industrial Operations Software portfolio as the new operation system for industry in the age of AI. With us you have the chance to now apply AI to where it really matters: In the physical world of an industrial production and engineering of real things.

As part of Siemens Operations Software (OPS-SW), the Technology, Data Fabric & Agentic AI organization provides the technology foundation that enables the next generation of industrial software. Its portfolio includes AI Production & Engineering Systems, Data Fabric, Agentic AI frameworks, connectivity platforms, semantic data models, cloud-native architectures, and industrial AI services that power autonomous, scalable, and intelligent operations across the OPS-SW portfolio.

What will you do?

Lead and grow the team – recruit, manage, and develop a team of AI/ML engineers and developers; own delivery, team health, and performance
Ship agent capabilities – drive the design, build, and delivery of specific agent capabilities from prototype to production-ready features
Deliver against the system – build on the shared frameworks, APIs, and orchestration patterns defined by the R&D Leader; contribute back improvements rather than diverging
Stay aligned, move fast – translate the global platform roadmap into a local team backlog and remove blockers so the team ships without waiting on the wider program
Stay hands-on – participate in architecture discussions, review code and technical designs, and make sound day-to-day technical decisions with your team
Own quality and reliability – ensure your team's work meets shared standards for agent communication, data handling, error recovery, monitoring, and observability
Bridge research and production – help your team apply modern AI research (LLMs, agent frameworks, orchestration patterns) to reliable industrial systems
Collaborate across sites – work closely with the Global R&D Leader, Project Leads, and peer teams (Erlangen, Fürth, and beyond) to keep one coherent system, not disconnected experiments
Represent the team locally – act as the technical and people anchor for the Canadian team; connect with local talent, partners, and the wider Siemens network, with opportunities to extend leadership influence across other Canadian R&D teams.

What you will bring:

Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in Engineering Management, Technical Leadership, or Team Leadership roles in software, AI, robotics, industrial technology, or platform engineering.
Lead engineering teams – you've managed and grown software/ML teams that ship, and you know how to balance delivery pressure with sustainable team health
Have strong technical depth – you understand LLMs and what makes agentic AI different from traditional automation; you can engage credibly in architecture and code-level discussions
Deliver in fast environments – you're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration, and you can create structure and predictability for your team where there is none
Build on shared foundations – you know how to align to a common platform and standards without letting your team become a bottleneck or a silo
Lead through technical credibility – engineers respect you because you understand the work and make trade-offs they trust
Balance innovation and pragmatism – you know when to try cutting-edge tools and when to pick boring, proven technology
Communicate across audiences – you can align your team, report up to leadership, and coordinate across distributed sites and time zones

What sets you apart:

Experience building agentic AI systems, multi-agent frameworks, or LLM-based orchestration platforms
Background in industrial automation, manufacturing systems, or industrial IoT
Track record delivering 0-to-1 products that scaled
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and modern AI/ML tooling
Experience with open-source AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Nemo Platform, etc.) and a clear view of their strengths and limitations
Previous leadership roles in R&D, platform engineering, or technical team management

Why you’ll love working for Siemens!

Join our Digital World

At Siemens Digital Industries Operations Software, flexibility is how we work – hybrid, built on trust and autonomy. We build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial operations software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers a wide range of health and wellness benefits to employees

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Siemens is proud to be an eight-time award winner of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers 2025 and Canada’s Top Employers for Young People 2025.

About Us.

We share our ideas and champion the people behind them.

Siemens Canada is a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, mobility and healthcare. The company’s purpose is to create technology with purpose, transforming the everyday, for everyone, since 1912. By combining the real and the digital worlds, Siemens empowers its customers to accelerate their digital and sustainability transformations, making factories more efficient, cities more liveable, and transportation more sustainable. Siemens also owns a majority stake in the publicly listed company Siemens Healthineers, a leading global medical technology provider pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

In fiscal 2024, which ended September 30, 2024, Siemens Canada had revenues of approx. $2.2 billion CAD. The company has approximately 4,400 employees from coast-to-coast and 37 office and production facilities across Canada.

To learn more about Siemens Canada, visit our website at www.siemens.ca

jobs.title: Director, Data Governance
jobs.description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future , is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders. Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien.

Nutrien is looking for a Director, Data Governance to build and lead our enterprise data governance program—strengthening data ownership, quality, and controls across key data domains so Nutrien can confidently scale analytics, AI, and digital products. Reporting to the Sr Director, Data Office, you will partner across business, technology, and risk functions to set standards, enable adoption, and ensure regulatory, and policy requirements are met globally.

This role will ensure critical data at Nutrien is trusted, consistent, and compliant across all data domains and business areas. You will operate at the intersection of business, data, technology, and risk—enabling scalable analytics, AI, and digital products globally—while ensuring regulatory and policy requirements are met and maintained.

What You'll Do:

Support the design and implementation of Nutrien’s global data governance framework across core data domains (e.g., product, customer, supplier, location, and asset)
Define enterprise standards for master/reference data domains and critical data elements
Drive the implementation of governance ownership and accountability across all data domains and lines of business, partnering with domain leaders to clarify roles, responsibilities, and adoption of governance practices
Balance enterprise consistency with business needs, regulatory requirements, and regional/functional nuances
Facilitate and support enterprise and business unit data governance forums (e.g., councils and working groups) ensuring alignment, issue escalation, and effective decision making
Drive continuous improvement of governance practices as the data and AI landscape evolves
Partner with IT and to define the enterprise data quality strategy, including standards, issue management, root-cause analysis, observability and remediation
Operationalize data governance policies and standards to ensure alignment with global and regional regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, residency, and confidentiality), working closely with Legal, Risk, and IT partners
Lead a team delivering master data maintenance for multiple data domains at Nutrien
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to support audits, client due diligence, and regulatory inquiries related to data and analytics
Lead data governance initiatives and change adoption efforts, influencing stakeholders and enabling consistent governance practices across domains and functions

What You'll Bring:

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
15+ years of experience in data governance, data management, master data, or related enterprise data roles
5+ years of experience in a managerial role with demonstrated executive-level influence and stakeholder management, including leading governance councils and driving adoption across a matrixed organization
Proven experience building and launching a data governance program from the ground up
Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization with regional regulatory complexity
Deep knowledge of data governance concepts, frameworks, and best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK)
Practical experience with ERP systems (specifically SAP), data hierarchies, and how master data is created and managed within large enterprises
Experience collaborating across multiple business areas and centralized functions within a large enterprise
Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team and stewardship community

What You'll Get:

Purpose-Driven Work
– Make an impact as part of a global team feeding the future and support farmers locally and around the world
Excellent Benefits
– Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, plus a retirement program with generous employer matching for your future
Grow Your Career
– Tuition assistance for future education and ongoing learning and training opportunities for career advancement pathways across the organization
Support When it Matters
– Employee Assistance Programs, inclusive leaves, and paid time for holidays, volunteering, vacation, and wellness
Thrive in a Strong Culture
– Guided by our core values we put safety first, act with integrity, are stronger together, and deliver with excellence in a collaborative, high-performing environment

Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!

Yonge-Eglinton

Status: Full-Time Permanent

Salary Range: $140,000-$150,000 annually

This role supports the healthcare brands across the FH Health portfolio (Pollin Fertility, Perennial and Wellness Haus). FH Health was founded by tech entrepreneurs to support Canada’s pandemic response with innovative healthcare solutions. We’ve since evolved into a leading health-tech company that transforms traditional clinic experiences by integrating diagnostics and care through technology. We are proud to support a portfolio of healthcare brands:

Pollin Fertility-A next-generation fertility centre revolutionizing patient experience, safety, and outcomes through advanced technology.
Perennial – Integrated primary and wellness care brought directly to retirement residences, improving seniors' health and quality of life.
Wellness Haus – A physician-led clinic blending evidence-based medicine with cutting-edge wellness care.

Learn more:
www.fhhealth.com
www.pollinfertility.com
www.perennialcare.ca

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Finance to lead and scale our finance function and support the growth and expansion of the business. This role will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with the executive team to drive financial performance, support growth initiatives, and shape the company’s long-term strategy. This role will also champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of modern financial technologies, including AI-driven tools, to transform and elevate the finance function. The successful candidate will bring a forward-thinking, digitally savvy approach to optimizing workflows, enhancing reporting, and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.The ideal candidate is a designated CPA with strong analytical capabilities and a proven track record of building high-performing teams, optimizing financial operations, and enabling data-driven decision-making in a high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy
Act as a strategic advisor to the executive team on financial planning, growth, and expansion initiatives
Lead the development of long-term financial strategy aligned with corporate objectives
Translate business strategy into actionable financial plans and performance metrics
Support capital planning, fundraising, and investor relations as needed

Financial Planning & Analysis
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling across all business units
Review financial results and identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities
Develop insights on profitability levers, cost optimization, and revenue growth
Establish KPIs and dashboards to enable real-time, data-driven decision-making
Partner with operations and clinical leaders to align financial and business strategies

Financial Reporting & Controls
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial statements in accordance with ASPE
Strengthen internal controls, policies, and financial governance frameworks
Lead audit processes, tax compliance, and coordination with external advisors
Accounting & Finance OperationsProvide oversight of day-to-day accounting operations, including A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory management and treasury
Drive process improvements, automation, and scalability across finance functions by leveraging modern technologies, including AI, to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and insight generation
Ensure compliance with regulatory, tax, and payroll requirements
Oversee financial operations across a multi-entity organizational structure

Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Build and scale the finance function to support company growth and expansion
Promote cross-functional collaboration across departments
Act as a change agent to reimagine and modernize the finance function from the ground up, delivering strategic insights and building a nimble, high-impact team

Qualifications

CPA designation (required) in good standing
8–12+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership roles
Experience in healthcare, technology, or high-growth environments
Strong background in financial planning & analysis, reporting, and operational finance
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives
Experience with ERP systems (preferably Odoo) and financial reporting tools
Deep understanding of ASPE and IFRS standards
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills
Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment

Why Join FH Health (Perennial, Pollin and Wellness Haus)?

You’ll be joining a mission-driven, fast-growing organization that’s reimagining healthcare with innovation at its core. This is a unique opportunity to play a leadership role in shaping the financial future of a company making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Apply Now

We look forward to learning more about you. If you're a strategic finance leader passionate about driving growth and innovation in healthcare, we encourage you to apply.

FH Health is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The Firm is consistently recognized as a leader across Southwestern Ontario, is home to multiple lawyers named among The Best Lawyers in Canada and has been recognized as a Top Employer, in Guelph, and across Southwestern Ontario, and Canada. The Firm is deeply rooted in its communities — supporting local organisations through fundraising, sponsorship, and volunteerism.

The Firm has experienced continued year-on-year growth. To support the next phase of growth it is seeking an experienced financial leader to serve as its first Chief Financial Officer (‘CFO’).

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior finance professional to step into a newly created, high-impact leadership role. Reporting directly to the Managing Partner and working alongside the Executive Committee and the Chief Administrative Officer, the CFO will be an integral member of the Firm’s senior leadership team — supporting ongoing growth by maintaining and enhancing the Firm’s enviable financial foundation and overseeing the Firm’s approach to technology / artificial intelligence.

The CFO will bring the financial discipline, strategic rigour, and professional services expertise that a fast-growing firm of this scale demands. This is a superb role for a candidate who combines strategic vision with hands-on execution, and who thrives at the intersection of finance, technology, and people.

Key Responsibilities

The CFO will provide leadership across the following areas:

Planning & Strategy – Work with the senior leadership team to balance financial stability with the need to transform the Firm’s systems and policies. Provide oversight and ongoing enhancement of the Firm’s finance and technology teams and systems. Build and maintain a network across the legal profession to ensure the Firm is aware of competitive trends and best practices.
Budgeting & Forecasting – Direct the planning and execution of the Firm’s annual budget cycle, with responsibility to ensure the Firm achieves its annual Profit targets. Reporting regularly to the Executive Committee and Partnership. Provide ongoing education to all lawyers on fee strategy and profitability.
Client & Finances – Develop and execute a plan to streamline the client intake process. Drive the ongoing improvement of financial hygiene process.
Lawyer Support – Automate and simplify financial processes to ensure that lawyers can primarily focus on client work. Work with the Partnership on the partner compensation cycle to align with the Firm’s strategy.
People & Culture – Serve as a senior leader across the Firm, promoting the development of a positive and proactive culture.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate will be:

CPA designation required with a minimum of five years leadership experience within a professional services firm — preferably within the legal industry.
Demonstrated ability to work both hands-on, personally delivering service, and strategically advising and guiding the partnership
Understanding of technology and the fast-changing digital environment, including experience with practice management, document management, and billing systems.
Familiarity with the Ontario legal market, Law Society of Ontario regulations, and the economics of law firm management — including partnership structures and lawyer compensation models.
Excellent people skills with a proven ability to build trust, influence and persuade partners, lead teams, and foster collaboration while driving change and adaptation across the Firm.
A superb sense of humour and a genuine willingness to work as part of a successful, collaborative, high-performing team.

A total rewards package commensurate with the seniority and scope of the role, including a performance-based incentive component.

new_jobs.title: Director, Data Governance
new_jobs.description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future , is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders. Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien.

Nutrien is looking for a Director, Data Governance to build and lead our enterprise data governance program—strengthening data ownership, quality, and controls across key data domains so Nutrien can confidently scale analytics, AI, and digital products. Reporting to the Sr Director, Data Office, you will partner across business, technology, and risk functions to set standards, enable adoption, and ensure regulatory, and policy requirements are met globally.

This role will ensure critical data at Nutrien is trusted, consistent, and compliant across all data domains and business areas. You will operate at the intersection of business, data, technology, and risk—enabling scalable analytics, AI, and digital products globally—while ensuring regulatory and policy requirements are met and maintained.

What You'll Do:

Support the design and implementation of Nutrien’s global data governance framework across core data domains (e.g., product, customer, supplier, location, and asset)
Define enterprise standards for master/reference data domains and critical data elements
Drive the implementation of governance ownership and accountability across all data domains and lines of business, partnering with domain leaders to clarify roles, responsibilities, and adoption of governance practices
Balance enterprise consistency with business needs, regulatory requirements, and regional/functional nuances
Facilitate and support enterprise and business unit data governance forums (e.g., councils and working groups) ensuring alignment, issue escalation, and effective decision making
Drive continuous improvement of governance practices as the data and AI landscape evolves
Partner with IT and to define the enterprise data quality strategy, including standards, issue management, root-cause analysis, observability and remediation
Operationalize data governance policies and standards to ensure alignment with global and regional regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, residency, and confidentiality), working closely with Legal, Risk, and IT partners
Lead a team delivering master data maintenance for multiple data domains at Nutrien
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to support audits, client due diligence, and regulatory inquiries related to data and analytics
Lead data governance initiatives and change adoption efforts, influencing stakeholders and enabling consistent governance practices across domains and functions

What You'll Bring:

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
15+ years of experience in data governance, data management, master data, or related enterprise data roles
5+ years of experience in a managerial role with demonstrated executive-level influence and stakeholder management, including leading governance councils and driving adoption across a matrixed organization
Proven experience building and launching a data governance program from the ground up
Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization with regional regulatory complexity
Deep knowledge of data governance concepts, frameworks, and best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK)
Practical experience with ERP systems (specifically SAP), data hierarchies, and how master data is created and managed within large enterprises
Experience collaborating across multiple business areas and centralized functions within a large enterprise
Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team and stewardship community

What You'll Get:

Purpose-Driven Work
– Make an impact as part of a global team feeding the future and support farmers locally and around the world
Excellent Benefits
– Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, plus a retirement program with generous employer matching for your future
Grow Your Career
– Tuition assistance for future education and ongoing learning and training opportunities for career advancement pathways across the organization
Support When it Matters
– Employee Assistance Programs, inclusive leaves, and paid time for holidays, volunteering, vacation, and wellness
Thrive in a Strong Culture
– Guided by our core values we put safety first, act with integrity, are stronger together, and deliver with excellence in a collaborative, high-performing environment

Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!

The estimated salary that Indeed, Glassdoor and LinkedIn lists does not represent Nutrien's compensation structure. Nutrien is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

This job will remain posted until filled. In accordance with Nutrien policies, you will be required to undergo a background check, and may be required to undergo a substance test. While we appreciate all applications we receive, only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Applicants must meet minimum age requirements, as permitted by law.

new_jobs.description:
Location: Toronto- Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

Yonge-Eglinton

Department: Finance

Status: Full-Time Permanent

Salary Range: $140,000-$150,000 annually

This role supports the healthcare brands across the FH Health portfolio (Pollin Fertility, Perennial and Wellness Haus). FH Health was founded by tech entrepreneurs to support Canada’s pandemic response with innovative healthcare solutions. We’ve since evolved into a leading health-tech company that transforms traditional clinic experiences by integrating diagnostics and care through technology. We are proud to support a portfolio of healthcare brands:

Pollin Fertility-A next-generation fertility centre revolutionizing patient experience, safety, and outcomes through advanced technology.
Perennial – Integrated primary and wellness care brought directly to retirement residences, improving seniors' health and quality of life.
Wellness Haus – A physician-led clinic blending evidence-based medicine with cutting-edge wellness care.

Learn more:
www.fhhealth.com
www.pollinfertility.com
www.perennialcare.ca

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Finance to lead and scale our finance function and support the growth and expansion of the business. This role will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with the executive team to drive financial performance, support growth initiatives, and shape the company’s long-term strategy. This role will also champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of modern financial technologies, including AI-driven tools, to transform and elevate the finance function. The successful candidate will bring a forward-thinking, digitally savvy approach to optimizing workflows, enhancing reporting, and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.The ideal candidate is a designated CPA with strong analytical capabilities and a proven track record of building high-performing teams, optimizing financial operations, and enabling data-driven decision-making in a high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy
Act as a strategic advisor to the executive team on financial planning, growth, and expansion initiatives
Lead the development of long-term financial strategy aligned with corporate objectives
Translate business strategy into actionable financial plans and performance metrics
Support capital planning, fundraising, and investor relations as needed

Financial Planning & Analysis
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling across all business units
Review financial results and identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities
Develop insights on profitability levers, cost optimization, and revenue growth
Establish KPIs and dashboards to enable real-time, data-driven decision-making
Partner with operations and clinical leaders to align financial and business strategies

Financial Reporting & Controls
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial statements in accordance with ASPE
Strengthen internal controls, policies, and financial governance frameworks
Lead audit processes, tax compliance, and coordination with external advisors
Accounting & Finance OperationsProvide oversight of day-to-day accounting operations, including A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory management and treasury
Drive process improvements, automation, and scalability across finance functions by leveraging modern technologies, including AI, to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and insight generation
Ensure compliance with regulatory, tax, and payroll requirements
Oversee financial operations across a multi-entity organizational structure

Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Build and scale the finance function to support company growth and expansion
Promote cross-functional collaboration across departments
Act as a change agent to reimagine and modernize the finance function from the ground up, delivering strategic insights and building a nimble, high-impact team

Qualifications

CPA designation (required) in good standing
8–12+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership roles
Experience in healthcare, technology, or high-growth environments
Strong background in financial planning & analysis, reporting, and operational finance
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives
Experience with ERP systems (preferably Odoo) and financial reporting tools
Deep understanding of ASPE and IFRS standards
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills
Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment

Why Join FH Health (Perennial, Pollin and Wellness Haus)?

You’ll be joining a mission-driven, fast-growing organization that’s reimagining healthcare with innovation at its core. This is a unique opportunity to play a leadership role in shaping the financial future of a company making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Apply Now

We look forward to learning more about you. If you're a strategic finance leader passionate about driving growth and innovation in healthcare, we encourage you to apply.

FH Health is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact careteam@perennialcare.ca for assistance.We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
